title: Yummy Australian Flour Flatbread
description: A garlicky, fluffy flatbread that kids love, made with simple flour, water, and a touch of olive oil for a nut‑free, kid‑friendly Australian treat.
instructions: In a large bowl combine the flour, salt, sugar and active dry yeast.
Add the warm water and 2 tbsp of olive oil and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes until smooth.
Return the dough to the bowl, cover with a damp cloth and let it rise in a warm place for 20 minutes.
After rising, punch the dough down and divide it into four equal portions.
Roll each portion into a thin circle, about 1.5 cm thick.
Heat a dry skillet over medium heat and brush each flatbread with a little olive oil before cooking.
Cook each flatbread for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and puffed.
Meanwhile, mix the minced garlic with a teaspoon of olive oil to make a garlic oil rub.
Brush the cooked flatbread with the garlic oil and sprinkle oregano on top.
Serve the flatbread warm, cut into bite‑sized squares for kids to enjoy.
Store any leftovers wrapped in foil at room temperature for up to 2 days.
